the badge is hidden when the cart is empty
adding items increments the badge
sorting by price low to high is numeric

reviewed.note: bug reproduction - fails until the app is fixed

scenarios.title: an order cannot be placed without a postcode

reviewed.note: bug reproduction - fails until the app is fixed

scenarios.title: tax is 8% of the subtotal

reviewed.note: Only subtotal $42.50 (exact $3.40), so REQ-TAX rounding is never exercised. Add a rounding case, e.g. $9.99 -> $0.80.

scenarios.title: the catalog is not reachable without logging in
a locked account is refused with the lockout message

reviewed.note: Asserts the REQ-LOCK message only. Add an assertion that login did not succeed (URL stays on login page).

scenarios.title: valid credentials land on the catalog
a wrong password shows the mismatch error
sorting by name A to Z is alphabetical

reviewed.note: name-asc is the default sort, so the grid is already A to Z on first render and the assertion passes on its first poll. It proves the comparator, not the act of choosing A to Z. Select another sort first to test that.

scenarios.title: sorting by name Z to A is reverse alphabetical
sorting by price high to low is numeric
orders of $75 or less pay flat shipping

reviewed.note: Matches REQ-SHIP at $42.50 and $74.00. The $75.00-exact 'or less' case is not reachable with this catalogue, so the boundary is never tested.

scenarios.title: orders over $75 ship free

reviewed.note: Matches REQ-SHIP at $162.50 and $76.49. No cart totals exactly $75.00, so a '>= 75' threshold, or any threshold between $74.00 and $76.49, would still pass. The catalogue causes this limit.

scenarios.title: tax is rounded to the nearest cent
a locked account cannot reach the catalog

reviewed.note: The catalog-redirect check closes the first-poll race on the URL check. The error-visible barrier accepts any error; asserting the REQ-LOCK text would stop a wrong locked credential from passing silently.

scenarios.title: the badge counts quantities

reviewed.note: A single cart line cannot tell 'sum of quantities' from 'max/last line quantity'. Add a second line (p2 x3 + p5 x2 = 5).

scenarios.title: tax is charged on the discounted subtotal
a customer cannot use the admin page

reviewed.note: 'No admin controls' is checked only through the stock inputs. The promo switches are in the customer DOM (hidden). Assert admin-panel hidden.

scenarios.title: order history lists the customer's orders newest first

reviewed.note: SO-1001/SO-1002 are observed literals (REQ-ORDER-02 gives no format). The totals tie the test to tax, so on v2 it fails from the 10% tax although the order is correct. The date column is not asserted.

scenarios.title: the average rating is shown to one decimal
a code disabled by the admin is not valid
freeship combines with a discount code
only one discount code applies per order
an unknown code is not valid

reviewed.note: 'Changes nothing' is asserted only as discount $0.00, the starting value. Assert the total unchanged. Case-insensitivity from REQ-PROMO-01 is untested.

scenarios.title: welcome5 needs a subtotal of 30 dollars

reviewed.note: $27.99 / $30.00 separates the $25 reading and pins >=, but any threshold from $28 to $30 passes. $29.97 (Espresso Cups x3) can be reached. The $0.00 discount after the refusal is the starting value.

scenarios.title: a customer can review a product only once
review text must be 10 to 500 characters

reviewed.note: Only the lower boundary 9/10 is pinned. The REQ-REVIEW-01 upper boundary 500/501 is untested (both builds handle it correctly today).

scenarios.title: a review without a rating is rejected

reviewed.note: 'Not saved' is only review-item count 0, the starting state, so it passes on the first poll. Also assert pdp-rating still 'No reviews yet'.

scenarios.title: every matching product appears exactly once across pages

reviewed.note: The deciding checks (18 cards, 18 distinct) are plain asserts that admission did not mutate. all_inner_texts does not retry. 'No Previous on page 1' from REQ-SEARCH-03 is not checked.

scenarios.title: kitchen with in stock only lists exactly eight products on one page
search matches product names regardless of case

reviewed.note: The LAMP query starts from a list that already reads ['Desk Lamp'], so it passes on the first poll if rendering is async or the input is ignored. Clear the search and assert the reset between queries. 'Lamp' is not tested.

scenarios.title: a search with no matches shows the empty message
the free shipping threshold is measured after discounts

reviewed.note: The $76.49 Free half repeats existing TC035. The value is the SAVE10 half ($68.84 pays $6.50).

scenarios.title: the regional surcharge is added to shipping
remote shipping is always 14 dollars

reviewed.note: FREESHIP is never shown to be accepted before switching to Remote, so the FREESHIP half passes even if the code did nothing. Assert shipping 'Free' under Metro first.

scenarios.title: stock set to zero by the admin blocks adding in the catalogue

reviewed.note: Checks only the Featured list. REQ-STOCK-01 / SHOP-17 require every list and the product page. Add All products and product-page assertions.

scenarios.title: a product with 1 to 3 left shows only n left

reviewed.note: Only N=2 is tested, so the 1 to 3 range is not pinned. Scented Candle (p15, 3 left) gives the upper edge without admin. 4 needs admin.

scenarios.title: an out-of-stock product cannot be added to the cart

reviewed.note: The product-page button is only asserted disabled. REQ-STOCK-01 also requires it to read 'Out of stock' there.

scenarios.title: placing an order shows the confirmation and empties the cart

reviewed.note: Round 2 (resubmitted after a round-1 rejection for a vacuous badge check on confirmation.html). Badge now asserted on cart.html (count 1, hidden); verified live that both the badge and cart-empty checks can fail. Weak spots: nothing asserts the cart was non-empty before the order (TC020 covers add-to-cart); REQ-CHK-02 promo clearing not covered; lines 26-29 not mutated by admission; REQ-PAY-01 only implicit.

scenarios.title: opening a product from the catalog shows its details

reviewed.note: Matches P-046 and REQ-PDP-01 (rating 4.5 out of 5 (2 reviews) verified live). Weak spots: the description check is only regex \S; the price is hardcoded $42.50 and not cross-checked against the catalog card; the review list required by REQ-PDP-01 is not asserted; the rating line was not mutation-tested (exact match, so not vacuous). Overlaps TC050 on the rating formula with a different data point; keep both.

scenarios.title: the admin checkout address starts as the saved address
an empty address is rejected

reviewed.note: Trailing orders-empty to_have_text is vacuous (element always in DOM, only hidden toggled); use to_be_visible() or order-row to_have_count(0). Docstring cites REQ-MSG-03, not in the plan's provenance for P-051.

scenarios.title: a full name shorter than 2 or longer than 60 characters is rejected

reviewed.note: Boundary step tests only the rejecting side (1, 61); the accepting boundaries 2 and 60 are not asserted, so an off-by-one rejecting 2 or 60 would pass. Add them in a later plan.

scenarios.title: a postcode that is not 6 digits is rejected

reviewed.note: bug reproduction - fails until the app is fixed

scenarios.title: empty username and password show the required message
logging out clears the cart

reviewed.note: Round 2 (regenerated after a round-1 rejection for a vacuous cart-cleared oracle). TC038 pattern now: cart-empty visible, exact text, cart-item count 0, badge count 1 then hidden; would fail on a build whose logout keeps the cart (traced in the app source). Admission mutants only hit setup lines 28, 29, 31; the cart-cleared checks (lines 35-40) were not mutated.

scenarios.title: order history shows only the logged-in account's orders

reviewed.note: orders-empty to_have_text is vacuous (always in DOM); use to_be_visible(). Does not prove standard_user's order still exists after the account switch, so a logout that wiped demo_orders would pass; re-login as standard_user and assert 1 row.
